name: Ferrari
look: Chiaroscuro near-black editorial, cinematic full-bleed photography, Rosso Corsa used scarcely, zero radius throughout.

hero.title:
TWELVE CYLINDERS.
NO APOLOGY.
hero.sub: Naturally aspirated, 9,500rpm, and mounted behind the driver where it belongs. The Aventine Tipo 12 is the last of a line we do not intend to replace.

features.title: BUILT AROUND THE ENGINE
features.sub: Everything else in the car exists to serve the twelve cylinders behind the driver.

items.title: V12, unassisted
items.body: Six and a half litres, no turbochargers, no electrical augmentation. The response is immediate because there is nothing in between.

items.title: 9,500rpm
items.body: A flat-plane crank and titanium rods let the engine run past nine thousand without drama, which is where it does its best work.

items.title: Active aerodynamics
items.body: A rear surface that reconfigures across three states, generating 390kg of downforce at maximum without a fixed wing.

items.title: 1,380kg dry
items.body: A carbon monocoque, carbon body panels and a titanium exhaust. Weight was removed, not offset.

items.title: Manual gearbox
items.body: Six ratios, an open gate, and a mechanical linkage. Offered because a small number of owners still ask for it.

items.title: Homologated
items.body: Developed alongside the racing programme and validated over 18,000km at Fiorano and the Nordschleife.

showcases.title: FIORANO, EVERY WEEK
showcases.body: The road car and the race car are developed on the same circuit by the same engineers. Suspension geometry, aerodynamic balance and brake cooling all arrived on the road car because they were needed first on the track.
points: Shared aerodynamic platform with the competition car
Brake package homologated for endurance racing

showcases.title: NO TWO ALIKE
showcases.body: Every Tipo 12 is specified in Maranello with a client and a designer across three sessions. Paint is mixed to sample, leather is selected from the hide, and the configuration is recorded and never repeated.
points: Paint matched to any physical sample
Hides selected individually by the client

gallery.title: THE CAR
gallery.sub: Photographed at Fiorano and on the Passo dello Stelvio, October 2026.

testimonial.quote: I have owned eleven of them. This is the only one I have driven where I could not tell you which part is the best part, because none of it is trying to be.
testimonial.name: Giulia Mazzanti

pricing.title: OWNERSHIP
pricing.sub: 599 cars. Allocation is by invitation, through your dealer.

tiers.name: ATELIER
tiers.desc: Specified with a designer in Maranello.

items.a: By the dealer network, in consultation with Maranello. Ownership history is the primary consideration, and the list for the Tipo 12 closed within eleven days of the announcement.

items.q: Is the manual gearbox a delete option?
items.a: It is a separate specification rather than a deletion, and it is only offered on the Assetto. It carries no price difference and a slightly longer build slot.
Seven years of scheduled servicing including fluids, filters, brake wear and collection from an address of your choosing. Consumables from track use are not included.

items.q: Can the car be used on track?
items.a: It is homologated for road use and developed on circuit. Track use does not affect the warranty, though the tyre and brake packages are treated as consumables.

cta.title: THE LAST OF THE LINE
cta.sub: 599 cars, and no successor planned. Speak to your dealer about allocation.

notes: The canvas is near-black (#181818), never pure black. White bands appear only inside editorial contexts.
Rosso Corsa is a single accent used scarcely — the CTA, the marque device, a race-position highlight. It never becomes a background.
Display weight stays at 500. Nothing in this system is bold; the scale carries the emphasis instead.
Every corner is square. Zero radius on CTAs, cards and bands is the luxury-automotive precision cue.
Depth is hairlines and photographic contrast. There is no drop-shadow tier anywhere in the system.
